The cue outlasts the motion it caused. SOLOIST holds the raised hand while CHORUS holds its completed advance, so the audience reads the changed formation as the reply rather than as passing background motion. GATE remains shut: the exchange lands near a boundary but does not claim to open it. The film ends on that stable relation.
